verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion is a fair privacy question for a local AI coding assistant, so the axis applies. The pack has no documented controls for retaining or deleting chat history, logs, or data sent to LLM providers. Local-model support via Ollama and git-based /undo are adjacent features, not retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
